questions.cardText:
[Engineering and Inventions] What is bronze primarily made of?
A. Copper and aluminum
B. Copper and iron
C. Copper and tin
Answer: C. This combination typically results in a harder material than copper alone, making it historically significant for tools and weapons.
questions.de: Bronze ist eine Legierung, die vor allem aus Kupfer und welchem anderen Metall besteht?
questions.en: Bronze is an alloy made primarily of copper and which other metal?

timeline.labelEn: The Bronze Age begins in western Eurasia (conventionally the mid-4th millennium BC)
timeline.labelDe: In Westeurasien beginnt die Bronzezeit (konventionell Mitte des 4. Jahrtausends v. Chr.)

questions.notes: Wikipedia: bronze is primarily copper, commonly with about 12–12.5% tin.

questions.cardText:
[Musicology] What is the term for a piece of music played at the start of an opera or ballet?
A. Symphony B. Overture C. Concerto
Answer: B. Overtures originally signaled the audience to settle down before the performance. Later, they also introduced the music, frequently including themes from the opera or ballet. Many overtures are still performed today as standalone concert pieces due to their catchy melodies.
questions.de: Wie nennt man das Instrumentalstück, das zu Beginn einer Oper oder eines Balletts gespielt wird?
questions.en: What is the term for the instrumental piece played at the start of an opera or ballet?

timeline.labelEn: A two-section ouverture already opens French court ballets (ballets de cour) by about 1640
timeline.labelDe: Eine zweiteilige Ouvertüre eröffnet bereits um 1640 französische Hofballette (ballets de cour)

questions.notes: Wikipedia: from French ouverture, ‘opening’; an instrumental piece introducing a ballet, opera or oratorio.
